item.title: Biography
item.description: I am a final-year PhD candidate in Mechanical Engineering at University College Cork (UCC), Ireland, working under the supervision of Prof. Guangbo Hao in the Compliant Mechanisms and Robotics (CoMAR) research group. My research focuses on the modeling, nonlinear analysis, and optimization of compliant mechanisms, with particular interest in slender beams and multi-stable structures.

item.title: Projects
item.description:
1. A Compact Flexure Guide for EM Vibration Harvester
    EU EnABLES project
    As the primary researcher on this project, I was responsible for the structural design and finite element analysis, encompassing both static and dynamic simulations. In addition, I developed two alternative design configurations for electromagnetic energy harvesters, which show promise for applications in renewable energy systems.
    2021
